description: University of Vocational Technology -Amended the Ordinance No. 1 of 2014 of the University of Vocational Technology by adding Item No. 6 that comes into operation on 01.06.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the schedule of an ordinance for the University of Vocational Technology by adding a new university college. The content pertains to educational matters and academic administration (specifically a vocational university's structure), which does not fit any of the government-related classifications (Types 1-3) or the specialized categories (Types 4-9). Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous (Type 10) for educational sector announcements.
